post.caption:
Coral polyps are animals that cannot feed themselves enough, so they host algae that photosynthesise and hand over most of the sugar. Heat stress makes the polyp expel the algae, and the white you see is the bare skeleton underneath. Reefs are under 1% of the seafloor and support around 25% of marine species.
